Pula aims to protect 100 million farmers from climate shocks by 2030. Climate modeling powered by NVIDIA Earth-2 will help it pursue that goal. 🌱

At The Earthshot Prize’s Impact Assembly in Mumbai, 2026 Finalist Pula announced it is joining NVIDIA Inception and will use Earth-2 https://t.co/ZqPj3VhMf7
